title: Split-Zero cohomology: original Gamma volumes and intrinsic spectral sums

source_cuts.scope: The accepted 75-page volume contains complete original baseline, quantitative Gamma return, intrinsic exterior/sum, endpoint and mixed-row proofs, with full current NOTE/JSR receivers. The independent K=q+1 family remains exploratory; canonical sources remain s=1,k. The m=1 finite centre retains its proved nonzero limsup radius. Complete OPG/OPR/OGN/PGCC observation calculations and dependencies are included as a separate source-only addendum, not as part of the 75-page PDF. Twelve complete dependency bodies missing from cut21 are restored, with the correction retained in provenance. Existing owner proof/PDF acceptance is reused; no new Lean check, PR merge or RH conclusion is claimed.
